title: CEL region-query functions for placement constraints
description:
Add CEL functions for checking uniqueness/exclusion constraints over defined regions of a grid zone. Enables Sudoku-level validation: "is this a valid play given what is already on the board?"

Functions needed:
- cells_in(zone, axis, index): all cells sharing a row/col/named region
- region_of(zone, pos): the sub-region containing a position (e.g. 3x3 box)
- values_in(cells): component values/types at those positions
- count(zone, filter): component counting with predicate (from DESIGN.md)

These compose with existing CEL builtins (contains, exists, size) to express:
- Sudoku: row/column/box uniqueness constraints
- Latin squares: row + column uniqueness
- Go stone legality: group + liberties check
- Queens: row + column + diagonal exclusion

All are pure state queries — O(board_size), guaranteed termination. Governed by decision baize-7a2.

Requires zone definitions to support named sub-regions (e.g. Sudoku boxes) — may need a schema addition for region definitions on grid zones.
close_reason: type_rows/type_cols in CEL context for placement constraints. Python evaluator supports .filter()/.size() with chaining. Fixed tokenizer precedence for != and ==. 2 new tests.
